description: Desktop only: the updater and process plugins are not built for Android or iOS (Cargo.toml, docs/mobile-android.md), and a mobile build refuses a permission whose plugin it lacks. Updater: check, download and install (not the download-and-install shortcut), plus process:allow-restart to relaunch into an installed update. The feed URL and signing key live in tauri.conf.json, so the webview can neither repoint the updater nor make it accept an unsigned build.
